original_target.title: Uniqueness of the positive Einstein metric on the four-sphere

scope_comparison: The torus-symmetry claim is withdrawn. The published twistor result adds fibrewise-constant scalar curvature, while other current results retain positive sectional curvature or a Yamabe-gap threshold. None of those proves arbitrary Einstein metrics on S4 are round.

primary_sources.locator: Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 1.2, extra twistor hypothesis
